title: Robert Temple's conversation with a female plasma being on a flight to Singapore

tellings.quote: he described a moment he was flying on an airplane and he said a plasma being entered the airplane and he had a lengthy conversation with her.

plain: A man named Robert Temple is said to have been on a flight to Singapore when what he called a plasma being, a living thing made of glowing charged gas, came into the airplane, and he had a long conversation with her. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD and studies psychics and the afterlife, passes this on as something Temple described to him: "a plasma being entered the airplane and he had a lengthy conversation with her." If true, it would mean that such beings can come among us and speak with people.
